Language: Python
Structure: Indentation-based blocks; dynamic typing; object-oriented and functional; extensive standard library; PEP 8 style guide
Conventions: snake_case for variables/functions; CamelCase for classes; 4-space indentation; docstrings for documentation; list comprehensions
Output characteristics: Readable, explicit, minimal syntax; whitespace significant; batteries included philosophy

Language: JavaScript
Structure: Curly-brace syntax; prototype-based objects; first-class functions; event-driven; asynchronous patterns
Conventions: camelCase for variables/functions; PascalCase for constructors; semicolons optional; callbacks, promises, async/await
Output characteristics: Flexible, dynamic; functional and OOP; DOM manipulation; JSON native; arrow functions

Language: Java
Structure: Class-based OOP; static typing; compiled to bytecode; package system; exception handling
Conventions: CamelCase for classes; camelCase for methods; explicit types; getter/setter patterns; interfaces and inheritance
Output characteristics: Verbose, explicit; strongly typed; platform independent; enterprise patterns; boilerplate heavy

Language: C++
Structure: Low-level control; object-oriented; manual memory management; templates; multiple inheritance
Conventions: Various naming conventions; header/source files; RAII pattern; const correctness; namespace usage
Output characteristics: Performance critical; systems programming; complex syntax; powerful but dangerous; zero-cost abstractions

Language: C#
Structure: C-style syntax; .NET framework; object-oriented; properties and events; LINQ
Conventions: PascalCase for public members; camelCase for private; XML documentation; using statements; async/await native
Output characteristics: Microsoft ecosystem; strongly typed; modern language features; Unity game development; enterprise focus

Language: Ruby
Structure: Pure OOP; blocks and iterators; dynamic typing; metaprogramming; convention over configuration
Conventions: snake_case naming; do...end or {...} blocks; symbols; DSL friendly; implicit returns
Output characteristics: Expressive, elegant; developer happiness focus; Rails framework; readable; flexible syntax

Language: Go
Structure: C-like syntax; static typing; goroutines and channels; interface-based; compilation speed focus
Conventions: CamelCase/camelCase; gofmt standard formatting; no unused imports/variables; error returns; defer statements
Output characteristics: Simple, explicit; concurrent by design; fast compilation; minimal features; Google style

Language: Rust
Structure: Ownership and borrowing; zero-cost abstractions; pattern matching; memory safety; no garbage collector
Conventions: snake_case naming; Result and Option types; explicit lifetimes; trait-based generics; macro system
Output characteristics: Memory safe without GC; systems programming; steep learning curve; modern features; cargo ecosystem

Language: Swift
Structure: Protocol-oriented; optionals; type inference; ARC memory management; playgrounds
Conventions: camelCase naming; optional chaining; guard statements; extensions; closures
Output characteristics: Apple ecosystem; modern syntax; safe by default; interactive development; progressive disclosure

Language: Kotlin
Structure: JVM/Android; null safety; coroutines; extension functions; data classes
Conventions: camelCase naming; val/var distinction; when expressions; Elvis operator; DSL builders
Output characteristics: Java interop; concise; null-safe; modern JVM language; Android official; functional + OOP

Language: PHP
Structure: Server-side scripting; $ variables; associative arrays; loosely typed; embedded in HTML
Conventions: snake_case or camelCase; <?php tags; WordPress/Laravel patterns; superglobals
Output characteristics: Web focused; easy deployment; large ecosystem; WordPress dominance; improving modern features

Language: TypeScript
Structure: JavaScript superset; static typing; interfaces; generics; compilation to JS
Conventions: JavaScript conventions plus type annotations; interface naming; strict mode; decorator patterns
Output characteristics: Type-safe JavaScript; tooling support; gradual typing; Angular default; enterprise JavaScript

Language: Scala
Structure: JVM; object-functional fusion; pattern matching; traits; immutability emphasis
Conventions: camelCase; functional style preferred; case classes; for comprehensions; implicit parameters
Output characteristics: Academic and practical; complex type system; concise; big data Spark; multi-paradigm

Language: Haskell
Structure: Pure functional; lazy evaluation; strong static typing; type inference; monads
Conventions: camelCase; point-free style; do notation; type signatures; pattern matching
Output characteristics: Mathematical; purely functional; lazy; advanced type system; academic influence; elegant abstractions

Language: Erlang
Structure: Actor model; functional; pattern matching; OTP framework; message passing
Conventions: snake_case; atoms; tuple patterns; guard clauses; supervisor trees
Output characteristics: Fault-tolerant; distributed; telecom origins; hot code swapping; concurrent by default

Language: Elixir
Structure: Erlang VM; functional; pattern matching; pipe operator; macro system
Conventions: snake_case; |> pipe; with statements; protocol-based polymorphism; Phoenix framework
Output characteristics: Ruby-like syntax on Erlang; scalable; concurrent; web focus; modern functional

Language: Clojure

Conventions: kebab-case; prefix notation; threading macros; destructuring; namespace organization
Output characteristics: Lisp on JVM; REPL-driven; immutable by default; simple syntax; powerful macros

Language: R
Structure: Statistical computing; vectorized operations; data frames; formula syntax; functional
Conventions: period.separated or snake_case; <- assignment; tidyverse style; ggplot2 patterns
Output characteristics: Data analysis focus; statistical packages; academic use; visualization; vector-oriented

Language: MATLAB
Structure: Matrix operations; numeric computing; proprietary; function files; scripts
Conventions: camelCase or snake_case; 1-indexed arrays; vectorization emphasis; function handles

Language: Julia
Structure: Multiple dispatch; JIT compilation; optional typing; metaprogramming; REPL
Conventions: snake_case; ! for mutation; broadcasting dot syntax; @macros; type annotations
Output characteristics: Scientific computing; Python-like but fast; multiple dispatch core; modern; growing ecosystem

Language: Perl

Output characteristics: TMTOWTDI; regex powerful; system administration; text manipulation; readable/writable debate

Language: Lua
Structure: Lightweight; tables as primary structure; metatables; coroutines; embeddable

Language: Assembly

Language: SQL

Language: HTML

Output characteristics: Document structure; semantic meaning; browser rendering; accessibility; not programming language

Language: CSS

Language: Shell/Bash

Language: Dart

Language: Objective-C

Output characteristics: Apple legacy; verbose; iOS/macOS older apps; dynamic runtime; being replaced by Swift
